stories.title: Create BEV C02 Knowledge Assessment with Battery Management System Diagnostics
stories.description: Develop comprehensive KA for BEV C02 covering battery management system theory, diagnostics, and troubleshooting with scenario-based questions aligned to NOSS assessment criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: Create file G452-010-3-2023-C02/KA(Batteries).md with minimum 15 multiple-choice and short-answer questions covering BMS components, charging protocols, fault detection codes
Include integrated answer scheme with point allocations and marking rubric (0-3 scale) aligned to CoCU assessment criteria emphasizing safety and diagnostic accuracy
Validate question distribution: 40% recall (Bloom's L1-L2), 50% application (L3-L4), 10% analysis (L5-L6) using bloom_level field in question metadata
technicalNotes: File to modify: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C02/KA(Batteries).md (create with question.yml structure for Bloom's parsing)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_bev_c02_ka_validation.py::test_blooms_distribution -v
Validate question count and rubric field presence using pydantic schema

stories.title: Implement NOSS CoCU Related Knowledge Dependency Mapper
stories.description: Build automated tool that validates every Related Knowledge item in NOSS CoCU has supporting KP (knowledge paper) content, generating comprehensive coverage audit report.
acceptanceCriteria: Create script scripts/validate_rk_coverage.py that reads prd.json RelatedKnowledge arrays for all 3 subjects and scans for corresponding KP files with matching RK reference codes
Generate audit report listing: (1) covered RK items with file paths, (2) missing KP files (orphaned RK), (3) KP files without CoCU reference (undocumented content)
Exit code 0 for 100% coverage, non-zero with stderr warnings for partial coverage; designed for CI/CD integration
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/validate_rk_coverage.py (main), scripts/rk_parser.py (utility)
Test command: uv run python scripts/validate_rk_coverage.py bev aesthetic it && uv run pytest tests/test_rk_dependency_mapper.py -v
Use JSON schema validation for prd.json RelatedKnowledge structure

acceptanceCriteria: Create file S960-002-3-2020-C01/KA(Consultation).md with 12+ scenario-based questions covering consultation techniques, problem identification, recommendation justification, and documentation requirements

technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/C01/KA(Consultation).md with bilingual content markers (EN / BM) in YAML

stories.title: Build Assessment Answer Scheme Validation Tool Against CoCU Assessment Criteria
stories.description: Automated tool that validates KA/PA answer schemes and marking rubrics align with official NOSS CoCU Assessment Criteria requirements and competency emphasis.
acceptanceCriteria: Create script scripts/validate_answer_schemes.py that parses KA/PA markdown files, extracts answer_scheme and rubric metadata, cross-references against prd.json AssessmentCriteria for each CoCU
Generate report showing: (1) criteria coverage percentage per KA/PA, (2) rubric point allocation alignment, (3) safety/compliance emphasis gaps relative to CoCU
Flag if assessment rubric weight distribution (safety %, technical %, soft skills %) differs from CoCU criteria thresholds
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/validate_answer_schemes.py with YAML parser for KA/PA metadata
Test command: uv run python scripts/validate_answer_schemes.py bev_c01_ka && uv run pytest tests/test_answer_scheme_validator.py::test_criteria_alignment -v
Validate using pydantic AssessmentRubric schema with criteria_mapping constraints

stories.title: Create BEV C01 Performance Assessment with High-Voltage Safety Competency Rubrics
stories.description: Build comprehensive PA for BEV C01 evaluating hands-on HV safety competency including PPE usage, lockout procedures, and emergency response with multi-level rubrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Create file G452-010-3-2023-C01/PA(HVSafety).md with 5+ safety scenario cases: HV isolation procedures, PPE verification, fault response, emergency shutdown, tool inspection
Include multi-point performance rubric (0-3 scale: Cannot demonstrate / Demonstrates with support / Demonstrates independently / Demonstrates & mentors) for each procedure step

stories.title: Implement Training Hours Distribution Validator for 30/70 Knowledge/Performance Split
stories.description: Automated tool ensuring lesson plan allocations comply with mandatory 30% knowledge-based / 70% performance-based training hour distribution across all CUs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create script scripts/validate_training_distribution.py that parses all PM-teori.md and PM-amali.md files, extracts duration hours from header metadata, calculates K/P split per CU
Generate compliance report: per-CU K/P split percentage, cumulative subject total, flag any CU with <25% or >35% knowledge allocation as non-compliant
Exit with warnings for distribution drift; integrate health check into .spiral/monitor to track K/P ratio stability
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/validate_training_distribution.py with YAML duration parser from lesson plan headers
Test command: uv run python scripts/validate_training_distribution.py all_subjects && uv run pytest tests/test_training_hours_validator.py -v
Validate against requirements.md 30/70 specification using assertion math

stories.title: Build Cross-Subject Bilingual Terminology Consistency Validator
stories.description: Tool to detect EN/BM terminology inconsistencies and variations across BEV, Aesthetic, IT documents to ensure uniform professional language.
acceptanceCriteria: Create script scripts/validate_bilingual_consistency.py that scans all .md files for bilingual term patterns (EN/BM or EN(BM) format), extracts and builds term occurrence map
Output: (1) term frequency report, (2) inconsistency list showing duplicate terms with different translations and file/section locations, (3) auto-generated suggestions for glossary harmonization
Integrate with glossary.json update mechanism to propose single-source-of-truth entries for conflicting terms
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/validate_bilingual_consistency.py with regex pattern matching for EN/BM pairs
Test command: uv run python scripts/validate_bilingual_consistency.py && uv run pytest tests/test_bilingual_consistency.py::test_inconsistency_detection -v
Use glossary.json schema to validate proposed term mappings

stories.title: Implement WIM Document Structure Validator for Consistency Across All Subjects
stories.description: Automated tool validating all WIM documents follow required JPK Buku Panduan WIM structure (TAJUK/TUJUAN/PENERANGAN, BAHAGIAN sections, LANGKAH KERJA tables, SENARAI SEMAK checklists).
acceptanceCriteria: Create script scripts/validate_wim_structure.py that scans all .md files, validates required headers present per document type: KP requires TAJUK/TUJUAN/PENERANGAN; KT requires BAHAGIAN for each topic; KK requires LANGKAH KERJA table; PA requires SENARAI SEMAK checklist
Generate compliance report showing structure completeness percentage per document type and per subject; list file locations of missing/malformed sections with remediation guidance
Integrate into CI/CD pipeline (.spiral test-suites/compliance/) to prevent merge of non-compliant documents
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/validate_wim_structure.py with markdown header/section parser and document-type routing logic
Test command: uv run python scripts/validate_wim_structure.py all && uv run pytest tests/test_wim_structure_validator.py -v
Define validation rules per doc_type in JSON schema (wim_structure_spec.json)

stories.description: Build PA for BEV C04 evaluating practical competency in diagnosing and troubleshooting electric drive train faults through systematic diagnostic procedures and decision trees.

stories.title: Build Assessment Question Progression Analyzer with Difficulty Level Distribution
stories.description: Tool analyzing Bloom's taxonomy cognitive level distribution across all KA/PA questions to ensure balanced progression from basic recall to advanced synthesis.
acceptanceCriteria: Create script scripts/analyze_question_progression.py that reads all KA/PA files, extracts Bloom's level tags (L1-L6) from question metadata, generates per-subject and per-CU distribution histograms

Output: distribution percentages (L1% | L2% | L3% | L4% | L5% | L6%), identify imbalance patterns with specific examples, generate recommendations for question rebalancing with CU+question ID suggestions
Integrate health check into .spiral monitoring to track if assessment progression drifts from target 20-20-20-20-15-5 distribution
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/analyze_question_progression.py with Bloom's level extraction from question metadata
Test command: uv run python scripts/analyze_question_progression.py bev && uv run pytest tests/test_question_progression_analyzer.py -v
Validate distribution percentages sum to 100% and flag outlier questions

stories.title: Implement IT-020 Knowledge Assessment Completeness Auditor for All Levels
stories.description: Automated audit tool verifying all IT CUs across Levels 3, 4, and 5 have complete KA files with minimum content requirements and proper marking schemes.
acceptanceCriteria: Create script scripts/audit_it_ka_completeness.py that scans it-computer-system/L{3,4,5}/ directories, validates KA files exist per CU with minimum 12 questions, complete answer scheme, and rubric (0-3 scale minimum)

Generate completeness matrix showing: per-level status (L3: 6/6 complete, L4: 5/6 missing C05, L5: 3/3 complete), file paths with status indicators, remediation plan with estimated effort per missing assessment
Integration hook: auto-alert when new CU added to prd.json without corresponding KA file (blocks incomplete CU PR merges)
technicalNotes: File to create: scripts/audit_it_ka_completeness.py with directory scanner and KA validation rules
Test command: uv run python scripts/audit_it_ka_completeness.py && uv run pytest tests/test_it_ka_completeness_auditor.py -v
Validate KA markdown structure and question count using assertions and pydantic schemas
